svg.title: FB_HandshakeHw - test HS1: hard-wired 4-phase handshake (requester side), time-out and partner fault
svg.text: FB_HandshakeHw - test HS1: hard-wired 4-phase handshake (requester side), time-out and partner fault
Phases: step 10 Request (wait Busy, tHs 2 s) -> step 20 job (wait Done, tJob 10 s) -> step 30 Ack (wait Done removed, tHs) -> step 0, xDoneOut one call.
tick k (x 100 ms) - events change inputs before the call of that tick
ticks 2-15 normal job ; tick 20 new request, partner never busy -> tick 40 alarm 1 (20 calls = 2000 ms) ; tick 45 reset (qReset pulse to the partner) ;
tick 50 request with partner fault present -> tick 51 alarm 4 ; tick 55 reset ; tick 56 xStart still TRUE -> new request at once (see text: start is a level).
